name: Abishai
summary: A son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, and a bold captain in David's army. More than once he offered to kill David's enemies, and he saved David's life in battle against a son of the giant.

key_moments.title: Standing Over Sleeping Saul
key_moments.description: Abishai went down with David into Saul's camp by night. He asked to strike Saul with the spear, but David would not let him harm the LORD's anointed.

key_moments.title: Asks to Kill Shimei
key_moments.description: When Shimei cursed David and threw stones at him, Abishai asked to go over and cut off his head. David told him to let Shimei curse.

key_moments.title: Saving David's Life
key_moments.description: A son of the giant, Ishbi-benob, was about to kill a tired David in battle, but Abishai came to help and killed the Philistine. After that David's men said he must not go out to battle again.
